UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
PRESS RELEASE / IMPORTANT NOTICE
SUBJECT: RESCHEDULING OF CIVIL SERVICES (PRELIMINARY) EXAMINATION, 2026

Due to schedule conflict with General Elections in certain parliamentary constituencies, the Union Public Service Commission has decided to reschedule the Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination, 2026.
In partial modification of earlier examination notice, the Preliminary Examination earlier scheduled for 24.05.2026 is rescheduled to 14.06.2026.
Candidates are advised to download the revised schedule.
